name: Bedlam Arena

25000.name: The Arena Center
25000.description:
A grand atrium of polished obsidian and bronze torches greets you. Banners
of past champions hang from the vaulted ceiling, their names stitched in
gold thread. The Arena Master stands behind a carved stone podium, ready to
facilitate matches. A massive archway to the north leads toward the fighting
pits, while stairs spiral upward to a spectator gallery.

This is a safe zone — no combat is permitted here.

north.description: To the north lies The Arena Tar Pit.

south.description: To the south lies The Arena Spikewall.

west.description: To the west lies The Arena Dirt Ditch.

down.description: To the down lies The Dark Alley.

404.name: The Arena Tar Pit

east.description: To the east lies The Arena Ramp.

south.description: To the south lies The Arena Center.

west.description: To the west lies The Arena Gauntlet.

404.description:
A broad pit of black tar fills most of this chamber, bubbling sluggishly
and giving off a choking, oily reek. A narrow rim of stone runs around
it, slick with spatters, and fighters who lose their footing sink to the
knees in the hot pitch. From the galleries overhead comes the stamping
of the crowd. The ramp lies east, the arena centre south, and the
gauntlet west.

25001.name: The Arena Ramp
25001.description:
A vast circular pit of golden sand stretches before you, surrounded by
towering stone walls. The roar of spectators echoes from the gallery above.
There is nowhere to hide here — only raw skill determines the victor.
Blood stains darken patches of the sand.

south.description: To the south lies The Arena Edge.

west.description: To the west lies The Arena Tar Pit.

up.description: To the up lies The Arena Scaffold.

25002.name: The Arena Edge
25002.description:
Massive stone pillars rise from the arena floor, providing cover and
creating deadly corridors. Shadows dance between the columns as torchlight
flickers. A shrewd fighter can use these pillars to their advantage,
breaking line of sight and setting up ambushes.

north.description: To the north lies The Arena Ramp.

south.description: To the south lies The Arena Stepladder.

west.description: To the west lies The Arena Center.

25004.name: The Arena Stepladder
25004.description:
Ankle-deep water covers the floor of this sunken arena. Waves ripple
outward with every movement, and the footing is slippery on the submerged
stone tiles. Rusted grates along the walls drain the water slowly, but
it never quite empties. The damp air carries the scent of iron and salt.

north.description: To the north lies The Arena Edge.

up.description: To the up lies The Arena Arc.

408.name: The Arena Dirt Ditch

east.description: To the east lies The Arena Center.

south.description: To the south lies The Arena Crawlspace.

408.description:
A deep trench has been dug across this chamber and left as raw dirt, its
sides crumbling, its floor a churned mess of mud and gravel. Fighters
must leap or scramble across, and the footing gives way without warning.
The crowd's shouts echo down from the galleries. The arena centre lies
east, and a low hole to the south opens into a crawlspace.

25005.name: The Arena Scaffold
25005.description:
A narrow stone bridge spans a bubbling pit of molten rock. The heat is
nearly unbearable, and waves of shimmering air distort your vision.
The bridge is barely wide enough for two combatants to face each other.
One solid blow could send a fighter tumbling toward the lava below —
though enchantments prevent actual death.

west.description: To the west lies The Arena Catwalk.

down.description: To the down lies The Arena Edge.

410.name: The Arena Catwalk

east.description: To the east lies The Arena Scaffold.

south.description: To the south lies The Arena Slide.

410.description:
A narrow catwalk of planks and iron runs high across this chamber, hung
on chains from the vault and swaying with every step. Far beneath, the
floor is a bed of broken stone. Spectators in the gallery hurl jeers at
fighters as they inch along. East the catwalk reaches the scaffold over
the lava, and south it drops toward the slide.

25003.name: The Arena Slide
25003.description:
A series of stone platforms rise at varying heights above a shallow pit.
Narrow bridges connect the platforms, and the footing is treacherous.
Combatants must balance aggression with caution — one wrong step
could leave you at a dangerous disadvantage.

north.description: To the north lies The Arena Catwalk.

down.description: To the down lies The Arena Center.

25006.name: The Arena Crawlspace

north.description: To the north lies The Arena Dirt Ditch.

down.description: To the down lies The Arena Mudbasin.

25006.description:
The ceiling drops so low here that you must crawl on hands and knees
through packed earth between old timber props. The roar of the crowd
comes muffled through the stone, like surf heard from far away. Damp
seeps from the walls, and a sloping hole in the floor drops down toward
the mud basin. The dirt ditch is back to the north.

413.name: The Arena Mudbasin

east.description: To the east lies The Arena Hideaway.

up.description: To the up lies The Arena Crawlspace.

413.description:
You are swimming in a basin of thick brown water, warm and sluggish,
that clings to your limbs like porridge. Bubbles rise from the mud
beneath and burst with a stink of rot. A sloped hole in the ceiling
leads up into the crawlspace, and a low ledge to the east climbs out
into a hidden alcove. No gallery overlooks this place; the crowd is only
a distant rumble.

414.name: The Arena Hideaway

west.description: To the west lies The Arena Mudbasin.

414.description:
A small dry alcove lies hidden off the mud basin, well out of sight of
the galleries. Someone has scratched tallies and names into the rock,
and a ledge forms a rough bench where a wounded fighter could rest. The
noise of the arena is faint here, almost peaceful. The only way out is
back west into the mud.

415.name: The Arena Arc

west.description: To the west lies The Arena Sunblaze.

down.description: To the down lies The Arena Stepladder.

415.description:
A high stone arch spans this chamber like a bridge, and the fight takes
place on its curved crown, with nothing to either side but a fall to the
flooded floor below. A rope ladder dangles from the arch down into the
stepladder pit. The crowd leans over the gallery rail, howling for
someone to slip. West the arch runs into a blaze of light.

416.name: The Arena Sunblaze

east.description: To the east lies The Arena Arc.

down.description: To the down lies The Arena Spikewall.

416.description:
Great polished bronze mirrors line the walls of this chamber, catching
the light of a hundred lamps and hurling it into the centre in a single
blinding glare. The sand underfoot is hot as a summer beach, and
fighters squint and stumble half-blind. A trapdoor in the floor opens
onto a ladder down to the spikewall. The arc lies east.

extra_descs.mirrors bronze:
Each mirror is taller than a man, its bronze polished to a fierce shine
and tilted on a pivot so that the arena keepers can turn the glare
wherever they please. Their frames are dented where fighters have tried
to smash them.

417.name: The Arena Spikewall

north.description: To the north lies The Arena Center.

up.description: To the up lies The Arena Sunblaze.

417.description:
One whole wall of this chamber bristles with iron spikes, some longer
than a sword, their points dark and crusted. The floor slopes gently
toward them, so that every shove and stumble drives a fighter closer. A
ladder climbs through the ceiling to the sunblaze, and an archway north
leads back to the arena centre. The crowd above roars each time someone
is pinned.

418.name: The Arena Gauntlet

east.description: To the east lies The Arena Tar Pit.

west.description: To the west lies The Arena Fire Circle.

418.description:
A long, narrow run of the arena is lined on both sides by alcoves from
which blades on iron arms swing out at anyone passing. The floor is
scored with old grooves, and the walls are spattered brown. From slots
high above, the crowd watches and wagers. East lies the tar pit, and
west the flicker of the fire circle.

419.name: The Arena Fire Circle

north.description: To the north lies The Arena Dead End.

east.description: To the east lies The Arena Gauntlet.

419.description:
A ring of iron troughs filled with burning oil encircles the sand of
this round chamber, and the flames leap waist-high, hemming fighters in.
The heat is staggering and the smoke stings your eyes. Banners of past
champions hang above, scorched along their edges. A gap in the ring
opens east toward the gauntlet, and north a short passage leads into a
cramped dead end.

extra_descs.banners champions:
The banners bear the names and colours of champions who won the Bedlam
Arena, stitched in gold thread. The oldest have faded nearly white, and
the flames have eaten the hems of all of them.

420.name: The Arena Dead End

south.description: To the south lies The Arena Center.

420.description:
This chamber was built to trap: whoever is driven in here must fight or
fall, with nowhere to run. The walls are high and sheer, polished so
smooth that no hand can grip them. Sand lies thick and churned, dark in
places with old blood. South a single archway leads back to the arena
centre.

25000.name: arena master
25000.long_desc: The Arena Master stands here, arms crossed, surveying the crowd.
25000.description:
A towering figure clad in ceremonial black and gold armor. Countless scars
tell the tale of a lifetime in the arena. His eyes miss nothing.

description: A legendary arena where warriors test their mettle in opt-in PvP combat. No death, no item loss — only glory.
